reported_ci_failures.symptom: Windows process timed out before the grandchild PID marker was available; cooperative directive issuance raced the active addressed attempt; local process timeout assertions failed under full-suite load.

implementation: Wait for all cooperative checkpoint markers and each task's running attempt/session before issuing a directive.
Wait for process readiness markers, process exit or a bounded readiness deadline before asserting lifecycle outcomes.
Use a compiled Rust process-tree fixture on Windows instead of relying on PowerShell startup timing.
Give parallel process test runs unique temporary directories and split touched test files below 300 lines.
